note: Promotion to the tracked schema (v0.89.0). This pack's track and description were already non-empty in the raw source import, carrying the band-suffix content debt from the start (not a fill-empty case). "override": "band-suffix" replaces exactly those suffixed rows with authored band sentences, the same counted exception used for the sector-OS packs (v0.72.0) and Housing & Tenancy / Money, Benefits & Entitlements (v0.88.0). Track names, prefixes and the shared description text are copied verbatim from data/source/Cognition.X_all_blocks.csv; nothing else is touched.
